personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, map-driven civic command center that turns pothole frustration into seamless municipal action.

spacing.rule: Generous rhythm. Avoid cramped layouts. Ensure bottom CTA padding clears the home indicator.

do's: Use on the Map floating action buttons and sticky top filters.
Use on the Bottom Tab Bar.
Use for bottom-sheet drag handles and headers.
dont's: Do not blur individual pothole cards in lists.
Do not blur form inputs or text regions.

haptics.NO_TOLERANCE: always have switcher in settings or profile page
haptics.wiring: Haptic calls live inside these components (Button primary, TabBar item, SegmentedControl, FilterChip, switch, slider) they fire automatically on use. Dev agent does NOT wire haptics ad-hoc per screen. Wrap in a global triggerHaptic util mapped to a user setting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the top filter/category chip rows pattern (chip_row block rules) for Map filters (Zones/Wards/Status) and Admin Dashboard. This is P0 zero-tolerance.

Map the 5 requested status colors strictly: Reported = error (Red), Verified = statusOrange (Orange), Assigned = warning (Yellow), In Progress = info (Blue - explicitly allowed by user brief), Fixed = success (Green).
Always use a SafeAreaView for the main container of every screen.
Implement the Haptics global toggle in the Profile/Settings page and wrap all haptics calls in a global util checking that setting.
Ensure the Admin Dashboard conditionally renders features based on Citizen vs Admin/Engineer roles.
Include a strict gradient-to-dark scrim pattern anywhere text is overlaid on images (e.g., Report details header, profile banner).
Keep forms single-column, with a sticky primary CTA anchored above the home indicator inside a fixed container for the Report submission flow.
